items.name: q001
items.label: Facility is open and providing scheduled PHC services at time of visit.

items.name: q002
items.label: Current staff list and duty roster are available and match staff on ground.

items.name: q003
items.label: At least one staff competent to provide RI is available or scheduled.

items.name: q004
items.label: At least one staff competent in nutrition screening/IYCF is available or scheduled.

items.name: q005
items.label: Skilled maternal/newborn care provider is available where delivery services are offered.

items.name: q006
items.label: Facility has updated catchment population, settlements and target populations.

items.name: q007
items.label: Hard-to-reach, insecure and underserved settlements are identified with service plans.

items.name: q008
items.label: Functional water source and handwashing point with soap/hand rub are available.

items.name: q009
items.label: Essential service areas provide adequate privacy and are reasonably clean.

items.name: q010
items.label: Reliable electricity/alternative power is available for essential services and night delivery where applicable.

items.name: q011
items.label: Evidence of recent facility data/performance review meeting is available.

items.name: q012
items.label: Previous supportive supervision report is available and prior action points have been reviewed.

items.name: q013
items.label: Functional linkage exists with WDC/CHIPS/community structures for demand generation and referral.

items.name: q014
items.label: Referral facility, contact details and emergency transport arrangement are documented.

items.name: q015
items.label: Updated RI microplan reflects all settlements and current target populations.

items.name: q016
items.label: Fixed and outreach RI session schedules are current, displayed and communicated to communities.

items.name: q017
items.label: Planned fixed RI sessions were conducted in the last month.

items.name: q018
items.label: Planned outreach sessions were conducted; cancelled sessions have documented catch-up plans.

items.name: q019
items.label: Due/defaulter lists are generated and used for follow-up.

items.name: q020
items.label: Zero-dose and missed children are identified by settlement/community and linked to action.

items.name: q021
items.label: Functional cold-chain equipment is available and current temperature is within recommended range.

items.name: q022
items.label: Temperature records are complete and recent excursions were appropriately documented/managed.

items.name: q023
items.label: Vaccines are correctly stored/arranged; no expired or unusable vaccines are present.

items.name: q024
items.label: VVM and open-vial policy are correctly understood and applied.

items.name: q025
items.label: Vaccine stock cards are current and physical balances agree with records.

items.name: q026
items.label: No unexplained stock-out of priority vaccines occurred during the review period.

items.name: q027
items.label: AD syringes, reconstitution syringes, safety boxes and vaccine carriers are adequate.

items.name: q028
items.label: Vaccination history is reviewed and every vaccine due is offered during contact.

items.name: q029
items.label: Correct vaccine, dose, route and site are used.

items.name: q030
items.label: Used syringes are immediately discarded without recapping into safety boxes.

items.name: q031
items.label: Caregiver is told vaccines given, next visit date and what to do for common AEFI.

items.name: q032
items.label: Vaccinations are recorded immediately in register/card/tally as applicable.

items.name: q033
items.label: Staff know how to identify, report and initially manage AEFI; reporting contacts/forms are available.

items.name: q034
items.label: Coverage and dropout monitoring charts are current and discussed by staff.

items.name: q035
items.label: Penta1, Penta3, MCV1 and FIC performance for last 3 months is reviewed against target.

items.name: q036
items.label: Penta1–Penta3 dropout is calculated and corrective action exists if high.

items.name: q037
items.label: Children attending other services have immunization status checked and missed vaccines offered/referred.

items.name: q038
items.label: Vaccine utilization/wastage is monitored and unusually high wastage is investigated.

items.name: q039
items.label: Routine nutrition screening is offered to eligible children during relevant facility contacts.

items.name: q040
items.label: Functional weighing scale(s), MUAC tapes and length/height equipment are available as appropriate.

items.name: q041
items.label: Staff correctly measure and interpret MUAC.

items.name: q042
items.label: Staff correctly assess bilateral pitting oedema.

items.name: q043
items.label: Growth monitoring records are complete and abnormal growth triggers counselling/action.

items.name: q044
items.label: SAM/MAM are correctly classified using current protocol.

items.name: q045
items.label: SAM with medical complications is recognized, stabilized as appropriate and urgently referred.

items.name: q046
items.label: Uncomplicated acute malnutrition is managed/referred according to facility designation.

items.name: q047
items.label: Children enrolled for nutrition care are followed up; defaulters are identified and traced.

items.name: q048
items.label: Counselling covers early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding for first 6 months.

items.name: q049
items.label: Counselling covers timely complementary feeding, meal frequency, diversity and responsive feeding.

items.name: q050
items.label: Caregivers receive practical, individualized counselling rather than only generic health talks.

items.name: q051
items.label: Pregnant/lactating women receive nutrition assessment and dietary counselling.

items.name: q052
items.label: Iron/folate supplementation and adherence counselling are provided according to protocol.

items.name: q053
items.label: Vitamin A supplementation is available/provided to eligible children according to policy.

items.name: q054
items.label: Deworming is provided to eligible children according to policy.

items.name: q055
items.label: Nutrition commodities have current stock records and no unexplained prolonged stock-outs.

items.name: q056
items.label: RUTF/CMAM commodities are available and properly managed where the facility is designated for such services.

items.name: q057
items.label: Eligible children presenting for RI/OPD/other services are screened for nutrition risks.

items.name: q058
items.label: Nutrition screening, SAM/MAM, treatment outcomes and commodity data are reviewed monthly.

items.name: q059
items.label: Pregnant women are encouraged and supported to register for ANC early, preferably in first trimester.

items.name: q060
items.label: ANC contacts and follow-up appointments are recorded and missed appointments followed up where feasible.

items.name: q061
items.label: Blood pressure, weight and appropriate clinical examination are performed and documented.

items.name: q062
items.label: Routine laboratory screening/testing is provided or linked according to national protocol.

items.name: q063
items.label: IPTp, tetanus-containing vaccination and iron/folate are provided as indicated.

items.name: q064
items.label: Birth preparedness, complication readiness and maternal danger signs are discussed and documented.

items.name: q065
items.label: High-risk pregnancies are identified, documented and appropriately referred/followed up.

items.name: q066
items.label: Privacy, dignity, informed communication and confidentiality are maintained during maternal care.

items.name: q067
items.label: Delivery room is clean, private, functional and ready where delivery services are offered.

items.name: q068
items.label: Skilled provider coverage is available during expected delivery service hours.

items.name: q069
items.label: A uterotonic for prevention/treatment of PPH is available, in-date and appropriately stored.

items.name: q070
items.label: Magnesium sulphate and other required emergency obstetric medicines are available at designated facilities.

items.name: q071
items.label: IV fluids, cannulae, PPE and essential emergency supplies are available.

items.name: q072
items.label: Labour is monitored with the nationally recommended Labour Care Guide/partograph as applicable.

items.name: q073
items.label: Maternal vital signs, fetal condition and labour progress are appropriately documented.

items.name: q074
items.label: Active management of third stage/appropriate uterotonic administration is documented.

items.name: q075
items.label: Staff can recognize and initiate appropriate response for PPH, eclampsia, sepsis and obstructed labour.

items.name: q076
items.label: Maternal emergencies are stabilized as appropriate and referred without avoidable delay.

items.name: q077
items.label: Immediate drying/thermal care, skin-to-skin and early breastfeeding are routinely supported.

items.name: q078
items.label: Functional newborn bag and appropriately sized masks are immediately available in delivery area.

items.name: q079
items.label: Relevant staff can demonstrate basic newborn resuscitation steps.

items.name: q080
items.label: Birth weight, breathing, danger signs and other immediate newborn assessments are documented.

items.name: q081
items.label: Low-birth-weight/preterm babies receive KMC or timely referral as appropriate.

items.name: q082
items.label: Mother and newborn are assessed before discharge and receive early postnatal follow-up.

items.name: q083
items.label: Maternal/newborn danger signs, breastfeeding and return instructions are explained.

items.name: q084
items.label: Postpartum family-planning counselling is offered and voluntary choice supported.

items.name: q085
items.label: Maternal, stillbirth and neonatal deaths are promptly reported and reviewed according to policy.

items.name: q086
items.label: ANC, facility delivery, PNC and maternal/newborn outcome trends are reviewed monthly.

items.name: q087
items.label: Children are assessed for general danger signs and major childhood illnesses using current protocol.

items.name: q088
items.label: Respiratory rate/dehydration/fever and other relevant assessments are performed correctly.

items.name: q089
items.label: ORS and zinc are provided for eligible diarrhoea cases according to protocol.

items.name: q090
items.label: Malaria testing and treatment follow current national protocol.

items.name: q091
items.label: Antibiotics are prescribed only when indicated and correct dose/duration is explained.

items.name: q092
items.label: Seriously ill children are recognized, given pre-referral care as appropriate and urgently referred.

items.name: q093
items.label: Every eligible child contact includes an immunization status check.

items.name: q094
items.label: Every relevant child contact includes nutrition/growth assessment or screening.

items.name: q095
items.label: ANC/PNC contacts include nutrition, immunization/prevention and FP linkages as appropriate.

items.name: q096
items.label: Clients are not unnecessarily asked to return another day for an available indicated service.

items.name: q097
items.label: Community/CHIPS referrals are documented and feedback provided where feasible.

items.name: q098
items.label: Missed child health appointments are identified and followed up where feasible.

items.name: q099
items.label: Caregivers understand diagnosis/treatment, danger signs and when to return.

items.name: q100
items.label: Under-five attendance, key conditions, referrals and deaths are reviewed for trends/actions.

items.name: q101
items.label: Required RI, ANC, delivery, PNC, child health, nutrition and referral registers are available/current.

items.name: q102
items.label: Registers are legible, substantially complete and free of obvious duplicate/unexplained entries.

items.name: q103
items.label: Selected tracer indicator totals agree between register/tally/monthly summary.

items.name: q104
items.label: Selected monthly summary values agree with values reported to DHIS2/state reporting system.

items.name: q105
items.label: Routine reports were submitted within the required reporting timeline.

items.name: q106
items.label: Facility staff use trend data to identify gaps, communities and corrective actions.

items.name: q107
items.label: Tracer commodity stock cards are current and physical balances reasonably reconcile.

items.name: q108
items.label: Expired commodities are segregated and FEFO/storage standards are observed.

items.name: q109
items.label: Handwashing/hand-rub is available at point of care and appropriate hand hygiene is observed.

items.name: q110
items.label: Unsafe injection practices, needle recapping or inappropriate sharps disposal are not observed.

items.name: q111
items.label: Waste is segregated and sharps/clinical waste are stored/disposed safely.

items.name: q112
items.label: Reusable instruments/equipment are appropriately cleaned, disinfected/sterilized as required.

items.name: q113
items.label: Appropriate PPE is available and used for relevant procedures.

items.name: q114
items.label: Referral forms/register capture reason, stabilization, destination and outcome/feedback where available.

items.name: q115
items.label: Functional communication with referral facility is available.

items.name: q116
items.label: Emergency transport or documented alternative referral arrangement is functional.

items.name: q117
items.label: Serious patient-safety incidents/complaints are documented, reviewed and acted upon.

items.name: q118
items.label: No evidence of unofficial charging for services/commodities designated free under applicable programme policy.

items.name: q119
items.label: Previous supervision action points are tracked with evidence of closure or escalation.

items.name: q120
items.label: Supervisor provides and documents practical coaching for gaps identified during the visit.

tracers.label: ANC first contact in first trimester

facility.label: Kaiama Maternity and Child Welfare Clinic
